parameters.name: AdaptiveRouting
parameters.description: Configures origin-pull behavior across address pools.

parameters.name: DefaultPools
parameters.description: A list of default address pool IDs.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: An optional description of the load balancer for easier identification and management.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the load balancer is enabled.

- `true`: The load balancer is enabled.

- `false`: The load balancer is disabled.

parameters.name: FallbackPool
parameters.description: The ID of the fallback address pool. Traffic is routed to this pool when all other address pools are unavailable.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the load balancer. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListLoadBalancers](~~2868897~~) API operation.

parameters.name: RandomSteering
parameters.description: The configuration for weighted round-robin. This setting controls the weight of traffic distributed to different address pools.

parameters.name: RegionPools
parameters.description: A map of primary regions to their corresponding address pools.

parameters.name: Rules
parameters.description: A list of rules that define behavior overrides for specific conditions.

sub_parameters.name: FixedResponse
sub_parameters.description: The fixed response to return when the rule's condition is met.

sub_parameters.name: Overrides
sub_parameters.description: The settings to override for requests that match this rule's condition. These settings take precedence over the load balancer's main configuration.

sub_parameters.name: Rule
sub_parameters.description:
The content of the rule, specified as a conditional expression to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you configure global settings. Use cases:

- To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

- To match specific requests, set the value to a custom expression, such as `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`.

sub_parameters.name: RuleEnable
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether the rule is enabled. This parameter is not required when you configure global settings. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

sub_parameters.name: RuleName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the rule. This parameter is not required when you configure global settings.

sub_parameters.name: Sequence
sub_parameters.description: The execution priority of the rule. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, rules are executed in the order they are listed. If specified, the value must be an integer greater than 0. A larger value indicates a higher priority.

sub_parameters.name: Terminates
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to stop processing subsequent rules after this rule is matched.

- `true`: Stop processing subsequent rules.

- `false`: Continue processing subsequent rules. This is the default value.

parameters.name: SessionAffinity
parameters.description:
The method for session affinity, which ensures that requests from the same client are routed to the same origin server. Valid values:

- `off`: Disables session affinity.

- `ip`: Enables session affinity based on the client IP address.

- `cookie`: Enables session affinity based on a cookie.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The ID of the Site. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API operation.

parameters.name: SteeringPolicy
parameters.description: The traffic steering policy, which determines how traffic is distributed among the address pools.

parameters.name: SubRegionPools
parameters.description: A map of secondary regions to their corresponding address pools. To assign the same address pools to multiple secondary regions, combine their codes into a single, comma-separated key.

parameters.name: Ttl
parameters.description: The Time to Live (TTL) for the DNS record, in seconds. The default is 30. The value must be between 10 and 600, inclusive.
